```yaml
name: CI Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'agents-docs/**'
      - 'packages/agents-core/src/**'
      - 'agents-cli/src/**'
      - 'agents-api/__snapshots__/openapi.json'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'agents-docs/**'
      - 'packages/agents-core/src/**'
      - 'agents-cli/src/**'
      - 'agents-api/__snapshots__/openapi.json'
  schedule:
    # Weekly Monday 6am UTC
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-docs:
    name: Build & Lint Agents Docs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build, Lint, and Typecheck agents-docs
        env:
          # Set 8GB heap limit to prevent OOM on ubuntu-latest
          NODE_OPTIONS: "--max-old-space-size=8192"
        run: npx turbo run build lint typecheck --filter=@inkeep/agents-docs
```
